text:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #17222 is failing the linux-smoke job after I rebased onto main. The failure looks like a docker startup timeout on shard-2. @maya @liam can one of you take a look? I can't repro locally.

maya: @alex looking now. which pool was this on? logs?

alex: pool: smoke-pool-2. here's the relevant part of the CI log:
```
2026-03-17T14:22:01Z [runner] Starting docker image redwood/smoke:20260317
2026-03-17T14:22:37Z [runner] ERROR: docker start timed out (30s)
2026-03-17T14:22:37Z [runner] Retrying... attempt 2
```

liam: fwiw I saw a similar flake yesterday after a kernel update on the ubuntu nodes. Could be kernel -> docker interaction. @ci-bot any node-side alerts around that timestamp?

ci-bot: Alert: host node node-17 reported containerd service restart at 2026-03-17T14:21:58Z. Related jobs: smoke-pool-2/*

sophia: if containerd restarted, containers might be slow to launch. may be transient — can we rerun the job? alex, do you want to kick a targeted rerun or wait for infra?

alex: I'll kick a targeted rerun for PR #17222 (only linux-smoke-shard2). If it flakes again, we'll request infra to check node-17 and consider pinning to another pool.

maya: SGTM. if it passes, we should still add a note to the PR description that smoke-pool-2 has intermittent containerd restarts. maybe bump the timeout for docker start from 30s -> 60s in smoke jobs as a temporary mitigation.

liam: +1 on timeout bump as a short-term fix. long-term infra needs to investigate the kernel/kernel-module update schedule.

alex: rerun queued: https://ci.example.com/teams/redwood/pipelines/17222/builds/4578 (targeted). I'll update the PR when it's done.

sophia: thanks. ping me if it fails again and I'll open an infra ticket with node logs.

alex: update: rerun succeeded on shard-2. merging after one more approval. tagging @maya for approval.

maya: Approved. :thumbsup: go ahead and merge.

alex: merged. added a note in PR about the transient node issue and created issue INF-413 to track containerd restarts on smoke-pool-2.
